recipes.name: CHICKEN PICCATA
ingredients: 1 tsp (6 g) kosher salt & more to taste
1 tsp (2.8 g) freshly ground black pepper & more to taste
3/4 cup (177 ml) chicken stock, preferably homemade
3 tbsp (43 g) unsalted butter, cold & cubed
1/2 lb (227 g) capellini, spaghetti, or angel hair pasta, cooked al dente
2 tsp (12 g) kosher salt & more to taste
2 tsp (5.6 g) freshly ground black pepper & more to taste
1/2 cup (118 ml) chicken stock, preferably homemade
4 tbsp unsalted (57 g) butter, cold & cubed
1 tbsp (3.7 g) parsley, chopped & more to garnish
1/2 lb (227 g) linguini, cooked al dente
instructions: For Basic Chicken Picatta:

Slice each chicken breast in half horizontally, but keep a small section attached so the halves remain connected. Season each with salt and pepper. - 2 chicken breasts skinless & boneless - 1 tsp (6 g) kosher salt & more to taste - 1 tsp (2.8 g) freshly ground black pepper & more to taste
Dredge the chicken in the flour and shake off any excess. - 1 cup (120 g) all purpose flour
Heat the oil in a large pan. - 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil
Add the chicken to the preheated skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes per side or until crispy and browned. - 2 chicken breasts skinless & boneless
Remove the chicken from the pan and reserve on a plate.
Add the capers to the same pan used for cooking the chicken, and cook them for 2 minutes. - 2 tbsp (30 g) capers drained
Deglaze the pan with chicken stock and lemon juice. Cook for 5-6 minutes or until the sauce has reduced by about 50 percent. - 1 lemon juiced - ¾ cup (177 ml) chicken stock preferably homemade
Turn the heat off and add the butter. Stir the sauce constantly until all the butter has melted. - 3 tbsp (43 g) unsalted butter cold & cubed
Season the sauce to taste with salt and pepper. - 1 tsp (6 g) kosher salt & more to taste - 1 tsp (2.8 g) freshly ground black pepper & more to taste
Add the chicken back to the sauce and cook for 3 minutes or until the chicken is reheated. - 2 chicken breasts skinless & boneless
Serve the chicken piccata with the pasta of your choice. Garnish with parsley. - ½ lb (227 g) capellini spaghetti, or angel hair pasta, cooked al dente - 1 tbsp (15 g) parsley chopped
For Babish Chicken Picatta:
Slice each chicken breast in half horizontally, but keep a small section attached so the halves remain connected. - 2 chicken breast skinless & boneless
Between two pieces of plastic wrap, pound the chicken to about ½ inch thickness. - 2 chicken breast skinless & boneless

Generously season the chicken cutlets on all sides with salt and pepper. Let the chicken sit at room temperature for 20-30 minutes. - 2 tsp (12 g) kosher salt & more to taste - 2 tsp (5.6 g) freshly ground black pepper & more to taste
Meanwhile, heat oil in a pan and fry the capers until crispy. - 3 tbsp (44 g) capers divided

In a shallow dish, add the flour. Dredge the seasoned chicken in the flour, then shake off the excess and reserve on a plate until ready to cook. - 1 cup (120 g) all purpose flour - 2 chicken breast skinless & boneless
Sear the chicken cutlets on each side until golden brown, crispy, and cooked through, about 3-5 minutes per side. - 2 chicken breast skinless & boneless
Once cooked, transfer the chicken to a rack placed in a rimmed baking sheet. Tent the sheet tray with a layer of aluminum foil to keep the chicken warm. - 2 chicken breast skinless & boneless

In the same pan used for searing, add another tablespoon of oil. Once the oil is hot, add the shallot and cook for 2-3 minutes. Then, add the garlic and remaining capers, and cook for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute. - 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil - 1 shallot finely chopped - 1 clove garlic minced - 3 tbsp (44 g) capers divided

Deglaze the pan with the chicken stock and wine, scraping the bottom of the pan with a wooden spatula to release the brown bits. - ½ cup (118 ml) chicken stock preferably homemade - ½ cup (118 ml) dry white wine

Add the lemon juice and lemon slices to the pan. Cook until the sauce has reduced volume by about 50%, about 5-6 minutes. Towards the end of cooking, add the chicken back into the pan to finish cooking in the sauce, about 2-3 minutes. - ¼ cup (60 ml) lemon juice - 2 chicken breast skinless & boneless - 1 lemon sliced into 1/8 inch slices
Remove the lemon slices and chicken from the pan. Reserve them for plating. - 1 lemon sliced into 1/8 inch slices - 2 chicken breast skinless & boneless

Turn off the heat, add the cooked pasta and ½ cup of pasta cooking liquid to the pan. Add the cold butter and herbs to the pasta, then stir until all the butter has been incorporated and the sauce coats the pasta. Season to taste with salt and pepper. - ½ lb (227 g) linguini cooked al dente - 4 tbsp unsalted (57 g) butter cold & cubed - 1 tbsp (3.7 g) parsley chopped & more to garnish - 1 tsp (5 g) oregano chopped - 2 tsp (10 g) basil chopped

Transfer the chicken to a serving plate and spoon the finished sauce over top. Garnish with the reserved lemon slices and more parsley. - ¼ cup (60 ml) lemon juice - 2 chicken breast skinless & boneless - 2 tsp (10 g) basil chopped - ½ lb (227 g) linguini cooked al dente
